concepts.learning_objective: Compute the scalar product of two vectors and use it to find the angle between them.
Calculate the work done by a constant force as W = F.d and interpret its sign.

topics.title: Kinetic energy, work by a variable force and the work-energy theorem

concepts.learning_objective: Relate kinetic energy to mass, speed and linear momentum.
Find the work done by a variable force as the area under the force-displacement graph.
Apply the work-energy theorem: the change in kinetic energy equals the work done by the net force.

topics.title: Potential energy and conservation of mechanical energy

concepts.learning_objective: Distinguish conservative and non-conservative forces and relate force to potential energy.
Apply conservation of mechanical energy to falling bodies and a pendulum in a vertical circle.

topics.title: The potential energy of a spring

concepts.learning_objective: Describe the restoring spring force F = -kx for an ideal spring.
Calculate the elastic potential energy (1/2)kx^2 and use it in energy conservation problems.
Define average and instantaneous power and state their units.
Calculate power from P = F.v and relate energy to the kilowatt hour.
Distinguish elastic and inelastic collisions by what is conserved.
Find final velocities and kinetic energy loss in one-dimensional collisions.
Analyse an elastic collision in two dimensions using momentum and energy conservation.
